purpose: Define deterministic one-time and recurring schedule semantics with explicit timezone, recurrence rule and daylight-saving behavior.

value.timezone_rule: Wall-clock schedules declare an explicit IANA timezone or explicitly declared UTC semantics.
value.recurrence_rule: Recurring schedules use an explicit machine-readable recurrence profile/rule.
value.dst_rule: Ambiguous/nonexistent local times across daylight-saving transitions follow an explicit policy.
value.date_rule: Calendar-date semantics and fixed-duration interval semantics are distinct.
value.anchor_rule: Recurring schedules retain an explicit recurrence anchor.
value.next_rule: Next occurrence is derived from schedule definition, anchor and occurrence history; it is not canonical source data.
value.locale_rule: Locale/display formatting never changes schedule semantics.
value.failure_rule: Invalid timezone/recurrence hard-fails rather than silently falling back to host-local time.

invariants.rule: A schedule determines when a scheduling occurrence may be emitted; it never directly executes a Routine, command or operation. Execution requires the normal explicit Event→Trigger→Runner/operation causality chain.

hard_gates.condition: calendar recurrence conflated with fixed seconds interval

references.purpose: Recurrence defines temporal behavior of exact schedules.
